001package services;
002
003import base.User;
004import enums.Role;
005import models.Course;
006import models.CourseRegistrationRequest;
007import models.Student;
008import models.Teacher;
009
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.Collections;
012import java.util.List;
013
014/**
015 * Course enrollment, teacher assignment, and registration request workflow.
016 */
017public class CourseService {
018    private static CourseService instance;
019    private final Database db = Database.getInstance();
020
021    private CourseService() {}
022
023    public static CourseService getInstance() {
024        if (instance == null) instance = new CourseService();
025        return instance;
026    }
027
028    public boolean addTeacher(Course c, Teacher t) {
029        if (c == null || t == null) return false;
030        if (c.getTeachers().contains(t)) return false;
031        c.getTeachers().add(t);
032        if (!t.getAssignedCourseObjects().contains(c)) t.getAssignedCourseObjects().add(c);
033        if (!t.getAssignedCourses().contains(c.getCourseID())) t.getAssignedCourses().add(c.getCourseID());
034        db.save();
035        return true;
036    }
037
038    public boolean removeTeacher(Course c, Teacher t) {
039        if (c == null || t == null) return false;
040        boolean removed = c.getTeachers().remove(t);
041        if (removed) {
042            t.getAssignedCourseObjects().remove(c);
043            t.getAssignedCourses().remove(c.getCourseID());
044            db.save();
045        }
046        return removed;
047    }
048
049    public boolean registerStudent(Course c, Student s) {
050        if (c == null || s == null) return false;
051        if (!c.hasSpace()) return false;
052        if (c.getStudents().contains(s)) return false;
053        c.getStudents().add(s);
054        if (!s.getEnrolledCourseObjects().contains(c)) s.getEnrolledCourseObjects().add(c);
055        if (!s.getEnrolledCourses().contains(c.getCourseID())) s.getEnrolledCourses().add(c.getCourseID());
056        db.save();
057        return true;
058    }
059
060    public boolean dropStudent(Course c, Student s) {
061        if (c == null || s == null) return false;
062        boolean removed = c.getStudents().remove(s);
063        if (removed) {
064            s.getEnrolledCourseObjects().remove(c);
065            s.getEnrolledCourses().remove(c.getCourseID());
066            db.save();
067        }
068        return removed;
069    }
070
071    public List<Student> viewStudentsAtCourse(Course c) {
072        if (c == null) return Collections.emptyList();
073        return new ArrayList<>(c.getStudents());
074    }
075
076    public List<Teacher> viewTeachersAtCourse(Course c) {
077        if (c == null) return Collections.emptyList();
078        return new ArrayList<>(c.getTeachers());
079    }
080
081    public boolean addCourseForRegistration(Course c, int year, String name) {
082        // In current model, courseId is the "name"/identifier. Keep year for request metadata later.
083        if (c == null) return false;
084        if (db.findCourseById(c.getCourseID()) != null) return false;
085        db.courseCatalog.add(c);
086        if (!db.courses.contains(c.getCourseID())) db.courses.add(c.getCourseID());
087        db.save();
088        return true;
089    }
090
091    public CourseRegistrationRequest requestRegistration(Student s, Course c, String reason) {
092        if (s == null || c == null) return null;
093        CourseRegistrationRequest req = new CourseRegistrationRequest(s.getLogin(), c.getCourseID(), reason);
094
095        // Auto-approve when possible
096        if (registerStudent(c, s)) {
097            req.approve();
098            db.save();
099            return req;
100        }
101
102        db.registrationRequests.add(req);
103        db.save();
104        return req;
105    }
106
107    public List<CourseRegistrationRequest> getPendingRequests() {
108        List<CourseRegistrationRequest> out = new ArrayList<>();
109        for (CourseRegistrationRequest r : db.registrationRequests) {
110            if (r.getStatus() == CourseRegistrationRequest.Status.PENDING) out.add(r);
111        }
112        return out;
113    }
114
115    public boolean approveRegistration(String registrationID) {
116        CourseRegistrationRequest r = findRequest(registrationID);
117        if (r == null || r.getStatus() != CourseRegistrationRequest.Status.PENDING) return false;
118
119        User u = db.findUserByLogin(r.getStudentLogin());
120        if (!(u instanceof Student)) return false;
121        Student s = (Student) u;
122        Course c = db.findCourseById(r.getCourseId());
123        if (c == null) return false;
124
125        if (!registerStudent(c, s)) return false;
126
127        r.approve();
128        db.save();
129        return true;
130    }
131
132    public boolean rejectRegistration(String registrationID) {
133        CourseRegistrationRequest r = findRequest(registrationID);
134        if (r == null || r.getStatus() != CourseRegistrationRequest.Status.PENDING) return false;
135        r.reject();
136        db.save();
137        return true;
138    }
139
140    private CourseRegistrationRequest findRequest(String id) {
141        if (id == null) return null;
142        String norm = id.trim();
143        for (CourseRegistrationRequest r : db.registrationRequests) {
144            if (r.getId().equals(norm)) return r;
145        }
146        return null;
147    }
148}
149
